title: Maximum Score from Performing Multiplication Operations
goal: Maximize score by repeatedly multiplying and removing either array endpoint.
strategy: The operation index and number of left selections determine both remaining endpoints. Fill future scores backward so each left/right choice can reuse its optimal continuation.
